title: Argentinian Kimchi Date Tagine
description: A keto twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, featuring spicy kimchi and sweet dates.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with night salt and ferment (if using).
Heat the ghee or coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork shoulder in batches until nicely browned, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a plate and set aside.
Add the chopped dates to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the kimchi, warm spices, and browned pork back to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the meat falls apart easily.
Garnish with chopped Andean mint and serve hot.
